gaps.explanation: Re-read p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds, printed p6), p7 General Fund budget schedule (printed p20) and p8 Special Fund budget schedule (printed p21). Statement expenditures excluding transfers 1,156,353 = General Fund 765,641 (General government 429,097 + Public safety 123,651 + Aging services 71,232 + Library 68,060 + Park 73,601) + Special Revenue Fund Streets and public works 295,981 + Debt Service Fund Debt service 94,731. Detail 2,041,436 = General Fund 'Operating expenses' 1,650,724 (detail[4], p7) + Capital improvements 0 (detail[5]) + Special Fund 'Operating expenses' 295,981 (detail[11], p8 = p4 Streets and public works) + Debt Service Fund 'Debt service' 94,731 (p4 column, added in pass 1). Every fund is in detail from one source only; no subtotal, budget column or prior-year amount is recorded. The whole gap -885,083 is the General Fund: its budget schedule p7 prints Operating expenses 1,650,724 with its own 'Transfer out' row '-', while p4 prints the General Fund's spending 765,641 and a separate Transfers out 885,083 (765,641 + 885,083 = 1,650,724; also p4 General Fund 'Total other financing sources and uses' 1,650,724). So the 885,083 transfer out is inside the printed schedule line Operating expenses 1,650,724. Nothing is counted twice (the transfer is not also in detail as a Transfers Out line), and the printed schedule line is not split or relabelled. The p4 General Fund column does print the exact breakdown of the 1,650,724, so the line could be replaced by the six p4 cells if the user wants the statement presentation; not done here because the brief does not allow removing a printed line that is not a duplicate. 2,041,436 - 885,083 = 1,156,353.

p4 Transfers out: General Fund 885,083, Special Revenue Fund '-', Debt Service Fund '-' (Total 885,083). Detail transfers out = 0: the p7 General Fund budget schedule prints 'Transfer out' actual '-' (detail[6], recorded at 0) and carries the 885,083 inside 'Operating expenses' 1,650,724 (detail[4]; see the expenditure entry). The p6 proprietary statement prints no transfer rows. Adding a Transfers Out -885,083 line from p4 would count that money twice, so it is not added. Transfers in (General 889,439, Special Revenue 722,309, p4) are in detail from pass 2.
